cards.example_en: The water balloon will burst if you squeeze it too hard.
cards.example_zh: 你要是捏得太用力，水气球就会爆裂。

cards.example_en: The dog tried to bury its bone in the garden.
cards.example_zh: 那只狗想把骨头埋进花园里。

cards.example_en: Wait for me at the bus-stop opposite the sports centre.
cards.example_zh: 在体育中心对面的公共汽车站等我。

cards.example_en: A button fell off my coat in the playground.
cards.example_zh: 一颗扣子在操场上从我的外套掉了下来。

cards.example_en: Bye! See you tomorrow morning.
cards.example_zh: 再见！明天早上见。

cards.example_en: The worker repaired the cable after the storm.
cards.example_zh: 暴风雨过后，工人把电缆修好了。

cards.example_en: We met at a quiet café near school.
cards.example_zh: 我们在学校附近一家安静的咖啡馆见面。

cards.example_en: The bird flew out of the cage.
cards.example_zh: 鸟飞出了笼子。

cards.example_en: Calculate the total cost before you pay the cashier.
cards.example_zh: 付给收银员之前，先把总价算清楚。

cards.example_en: Check your calculation before you write the final answer.
cards.example_zh: 写下最终答案之前，先核对你的计算。

cards.example_en: I forgot my calculator and had to work out the sums by hand.
cards.example_zh: 我忘了带计算器，只好用手把这些题算出来。

cards.example_en: He practises calligraphy every Sunday.
cards.example_zh: 他每周日练书法。

cards.example_en: A camel can go without water for days.
cards.example_zh: 骆驼可以好多天不喝水。

cards.example_en: The new campaign asks families to save water at home.
cards.example_zh: 新的运动号召家家户户在家里节约用水。

cards.example_en: The canteen serves rice and vegetables.
cards.example_zh: 食堂供应米饭和蔬菜。

cards.example_en: She was chosen as team captain.
cards.example_zh: 她被选为队长。

cards.example_en: The street carnival filled the square with music and bright lights.
cards.example_zh: 街头狂欢节让广场充满了音乐和明亮的灯光。

cards.example_en: We found empty seats in the last carriage of the train.
cards.example_zh: 我们在火车最后一节车厢找到了空位。

cards.example_en: Push the cart slowly so the eggs do not roll off.
cards.example_zh: 慢慢推这辆手推车，免得鸡蛋滚下去。

cards.example_en: Please recycle the milk carton after you finish your drink.
cards.example_zh: 喝完后请把牛奶纸盒拿去回收。

cards.example_en: The cashier gave me the wrong change at the supermarket.
cards.example_zh: 超市的收银员把零钱找错了。

cards.example_en: The old castle stands on the hill.
cards.example_zh: 古老的城堡立在山上。

cards.example_en: Put each word in the right category.
cards.example_zh: 把每个词放进正确的类别。

cards.example_en: Cattle were grazing in the field.
cards.example_zh: 牛在田里吃草。

cards.example_en: We looked into the dark cave.
cards.example_zh: 我们向黑暗的洞穴里看。

cards.example_en: A lamp hung from the ceiling.
cards.example_zh: 一盏灯挂在天花板上。

cards.example_en: The victory celebration lasted until late at night.
cards.example_zh: 胜利庆典一直持续到深夜。

cards.example_en: Each cell in the leaf needs sunlight to live.
cards.example_zh: 叶子里的每个细胞都需要阳光才能存活。

cards.example_en: The insect is one centimetre long.
cards.example_zh: 这只昆虫长一厘米。

cards.example_en: She received a certificate after the swimming test.
cards.example_zh: 游泳测验之后，她拿到了证书。

cards.example_en: He locked his bike with a strong chain.
cards.example_zh: 他用一根结实的链条把自行车锁上了。

cards.example_en: The chairman opened the meeting with a short speech.
cards.example_zh: 主席用一段简短的讲话开始了会议。

cards.example_en: The chairwoman opened the meeting.
cards.example_zh: 女主席宣布会议开始。

cards.example_en: Adults drank champagne at the wedding while we had juice.
cards.example_zh: 婚礼上大人们喝香槟，我们喝果汁。

cards.example_en: Fans began to chant the team name as the players ran out.
cards.example_zh: 球员出场时，球迷开始反复喊着队名。

cards.example_en: The last chapter of the novel made her cry.
cards.example_zh: 小说的最后一章让她哭了。

cards.example_en: Grandpa cooked fish over charcoal in the backyard last night.
cards.example_zh: 昨晚爷爷在后院用木炭烤鱼。

cards.example_en: The police dropped the charge after new evidence appeared.
cards.example_zh: 新证据出现后，警方撤销了这项指控。

cards.example_en: The weather chart shows rain for the whole week.
cards.example_zh: 天气图表显示整整一周都会下雨。

cards.example_en: The puppy began to chase a ball across the field.
cards.example_zh: 小狗开始追着球跑过球场。

cards.example_en: There was a long queue at the checkout on Saturday afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 星期六下午，收银台前排着长队。

cards.example_en: He ordered a cheeseburger and fries after football practice.
cards.example_zh: 足球训练后，他点了芝士汉堡和薯条。

cards.example_en: Store the chemical away from food.
cards.example_zh: 把化学品放在远离食物的地方。

cards.example_en: He felt a pain in his chest after the race.
cards.example_zh: 比赛结束后，他感到胸口疼痛。

cards.example_en: Safety is the chief concern when we use the science lab.
cards.example_zh: 我们使用科学实验室时，安全是最主要的考虑。

cards.example_en: Many of my childhood friends still live on the same street.
cards.example_zh: 我的许多童年朋友仍然住在同一条街上。

cards.example_en: Add a little chili if you like the noodles extra spicy.
cards.example_zh: 如果你喜欢面条更辣，就加一点辣椒。

cards.example_en: I dropped one chopstick under the table during lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午饭时，我把一根筷子掉到了桌子底下。

cards.example_en: My grandparents walk to church on Sunday morning.
cards.example_zh: 我的祖父母星期天早上步行去教堂。

cards.example_en: He threw the cigarette away before entering school.
cards.example_zh: 进学校之前，他把香烟扔了。
